description: Update user-wide display and formatting preferences for the authorized user. At least one field must be provided; omitted fields are left unchanged. show_debits_as_negative only changes display in the Lunch Money app: amounts in API responses always use positive values for debits and negative values for credits. Returns the full user settings.

always_display_weekday.description: If true, weekday names are included when displaying dates.

always_display_year.description: If true, dates always include the year and month_day_format is not used.

auto_suggest_payee.description: If true, payee suggestions are shown when entering transactions in the Lunch Money app.

month_day_format.description: Format string for displaying month and day without a year (e.g. MMM D).

month_day_year_format.description: Format string for displaying full dates with month, day, and year (e.g. MMM D, YYYY).

month_year_format.description: Format string for displaying month and year values (e.g. MMM YYYY).

show_am_pm.description: If true, times use a 12-hour clock with AM/PM. If false, a 24-hour clock.

show_debits_as_negative.description: If true, debits are shown as negative values and credits as positive in the Lunch Money app. Display only; API amount signs are unchanged.

week_starts_on.description: The day on which a calendar week begins.

name: update_user_settings
